p7_b0.ocr: In the fiscal year 2024, Airbus SE's satellite constellation deployment encompasses various metrics, including Navigation Satellites with 20 units planned, 5 units launched, 15 units active, a budget of €150M, actual spend of €120M, and a variance of 20%, with a status of Operational and categorized as Under Budget.

p7_b1.ocr: Communication Satellites are planned at 30 units, with 10 launched and 20 active, a budget allocation of €200M, actual spending of €180M, and a variance of 10%, also labeled as Operational and Under Budget. Earth Observation satellites have 15 units planned, 5 launched, and 10 active, with a budget of €100M, an actual spend of €90M, a variance of 10%, operational status, and marked as Under Budget.

p7_b3.ocr: The Total Constellation comprises 65 planned units, 20 launched, and 45 active, with a total budget of €450M, actual spending of €390M, a variance of 15%, operational status, and categorized as On Track. p7_b4.ocr: The headcount stands at 450, with R&D expenditure of €50M and an investment in innovation of €30M, contributing to new projects and a headcount of 5, with an additional €10M and a growth rate of 30%.
